title.en: Magnetic dipole in a uniform magnetic field

hook.en: A compass needle is a small magnetic dipole. The Earth's field twists it until it lines up. It is exactly the physics of an electric dipole in an electric field.
hook.kn: ದಿಕ್ಸೂಚಿ ಸೂಜಿ ಒಂದು ಸಣ್ಣ ಕಾಂತೀಯ ದ್ವಿಧ್ರುವ. ಭೂಮಿಯ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರ ಅದನ್ನು ತಿರುಗಿಸಿ ಸಾಲಾಗಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಇದು ವಿದ್ಯುತ್ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ವಿದ್ಯುತ್ ದ್ವಿಧ್ರುವದ ಭೌತಶಾಸ್ತ್ರವೇ.

objectives.en: Find the torque and potential energy of a magnetic dipole in a uniform field.
Use the period of oscillation of a magnetic needle.

narration.en: A compass needle is a small magnetic dipole. The Earth's field twists it until it lines up. It is exactly the physics of an electric dipole in an electric field.
narration.kn: ದಿಕ್ಸೂಚಿ ಸೂಜಿ ಒಂದು ಸಣ್ಣ ಕಾಂತೀಯ ದ್ವಿಧ್ರುವ. ಭೂಮಿಯ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರ ಅದನ್ನು ತಿರುಗಿಸಿ ಸಾಲಾಗಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಇದು ವಿದ್ಯುತ್ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ವಿದ್ಯುತ್ ದ್ವಿಧ್ರುವದ ಭೌತಶಾಸ್ತ್ರವೇ.

body.en: A magnetic dipole m in a uniform field B feels no net force but a torque $\vec\tau = \vec m\times\vec B$, of size $mB\sin\theta$, which turns m towards B. Its potential energy is $U = -mB\cos\theta$: −mB at θ = 0° (stable equilibrium) and +mB at θ = 180° (unstable). The work needed to turn it from θ₁ to θ₂ is $mB(\cos\theta_1 - \cos\theta_2)$.
body.kn: ಏಕರೂಪ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ಕಾಂತೀಯ ದ್ವಿಧ್ರುವದ ಮೇಲೆ ಟಾರ್ಕ್ τ = mB sinθ. ಸ್ಥಿತಿಜ ಶಕ್ತಿ U = −mB cosθ: θ = 0° ನಲ್ಲಿ ಕನಿಷ್ಠ (ಸ್ಥಿರ), 180° ನಲ್ಲಿ ಗರಿಷ್ಠ (ಅಸ್ಥಿರ).

narration.en: A magnetic dipole in a uniform field feels a torque m B sin theta. Its energy is minus m B cos theta: lowest when it is lined up with the field, highest when it points the opposite way.
narration.kn: ಏಕರೂಪ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ಕಾಂತೀಯ ದ್ವಿಧ್ರುವದ ಮೇಲೆ ಟಾರ್ಕ್ τ = mB sinθ. ಸ್ಥಿತಿಜ ಶಕ್ತಿ U = −mB cosθ: θ = 0° ನಲ್ಲಿ ಕನಿಷ್ಠ (ಸ್ಥಿರ), 180° ನಲ್ಲಿ ಗರಿಷ್ಠ (ಅಸ್ಥಿರ).

title.en: On the board: a magnetic dipole in a field

narration.en: A needle at angle θ to B feels forces at its poles that form a couple: τ = mB sin θ. Its potential energy is −mB cos θ: lowest when m lies along B, highest when it points against B. Twist the needle a little and let go: it oscillates with period T = 2π√(I/mB). Example: m = 6.7 × 10⁻² A m², I = 7.5 × 10⁻⁶ kg m², and 10 swings take 6.7 s; then B = 4π²I/mT² ≈ 0.01 T.

say.en: A needle at angle θ to B feels forces at its poles that form a couple: τ = mB sin θ.
Its potential energy is −mB cos θ: lowest when m lies along B, highest when it points against B.
Twist the needle a little and let go: it oscillates with period T = 2π√(I/mB).
Example: m = 6.7 × 10⁻² A m², I = 7.5 × 10⁻⁶ kg m², and 10 swings take 6.7 s; then B = 4π²I/mT² ≈ 0.01 T.

title.en: A magnetic needle swinging in a field

narration.en: Turn a magnet away from the field and let go. The torque τ = −mB sin θ pulls it back, so it swings about the field direction like a pendulum. For small angles the period is T = 2π√(I/mB): a stronger field or a stronger magnet swings faster. This is how B can be measured.

caption.en: Turn a magnet away from the field and let go. The torque τ = −mB sin θ pulls it back, so it swings about the field direction like a pendulum. For small angles the period is T = 2π√(I/mB): a stronger field or a stronger magnet swings faster. This is how B can be measured.
caption.kn: ಕಾಂತವನ್ನು ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರದಿಂದ ತಿರುಗಿಸಿ ಬಿಡಿ. ಟಾರ್ಕ್ τ = −mB sin θ ಹಿಂದಕ್ಕೆ ಎಳೆಯುತ್ತದೆ, ಲೋಲಕದಂತೆ ತೂಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಸಣ್ಣ ಕೋನಗಳಿಗೆ ಆವರ್ತ T = 2π√(I/mB): ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರ ಅಥವಾ ಬಲವಾದ ಕಾಂತ ವೇಗವಾಗಿ ತೂಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಹೀಗೆ B ಅಳೆಯಬಹುದು.

tryThis.en: Time 5 swings and compare with the T readout.
tryThis.kn: 5 ತೂಗಾಟಗಳ ಸಮಯ ಅಳೆದು T ಓದಿನೊಂದಿಗೆ ಹೋಲಿಸಿ.

tryThis.en: Make B four times bigger. What happens to the period?
tryThis.kn: B ನಾಲ್ಕು ಪಟ್ಟು ಮಾಡಿ. ಆವರ್ತ ಏನಾಗುತ್ತದೆ?

tryThis.en: Release from 90°. Is the period still close to the formula?
tryThis.kn: 90° ನಿಂದ ಬಿಡಿ. ಆವರ್ತ ಇನ್ನೂ ಸೂತ್ರಕ್ಕೆ ಹತ್ತಿರವೇ?

body.en: A needle of moment of inertia I, slightly displaced from the field direction, performs simple harmonic oscillations with period $T = 2\pi\sqrt{I/mB}$. Timing the oscillations gives mB, and hence B if m is known. Electrostatic analogy: $1/\varepsilon_0 \leftrightarrow \mu_0$, $p \leftrightarrow m$, $E \leftrightarrow B$.
body.kn: ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಸರಿಸಿದ ಕಾಂತೀಯ ಸೂಜಿ T = 2π√(I/mB) ಆವರ್ತಕಾಲದೊಂದಿಗೆ ಆಂದೋಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಪ್ರಬಲ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ವೇಗವಾಗಿ ಆಂದೋಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

narration.en: A magnetic needle displaced a little oscillates with period 2 pi root I by m B. A stronger field makes it oscillate faster.
narration.kn: ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಸರಿಸಿದ ಕಾಂತೀಯ ಸೂಜಿ T = 2π√(I/mB) ಆವರ್ತಕಾಲದೊಂದಿಗೆ ಆಂದೋಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಪ್ರಬಲ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ವೇಗವಾಗಿ ಆಂದೋಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

title.en: Energy and torque of a magnetic dipole

caption.en: U = −mB cos θ and τ = mB sin θ for a magnetic dipole in a uniform field.

tryThis.en: At θ = 0° U is lowest: stable. At 180° U is highest: unstable.

narration.en: U = −mB cos θ and τ = mB sin θ for a magnetic dipole in a uniform field. At θ = 0° U is lowest: stable. At 180° U is highest: unstable. Turning from 0° to 180° needs work 2mB. Where is the torque largest?

caption.en: Move a compass around a bar magnet and watch its needle line up with the field.

tryThis.en: Drag the compass all round the magnet: the needle always points along the field line there.
Flip the magnet: every needle turns round by 180°.
Notice that the needle swings a few times before it settles: that is the oscillation of a dipole in a field.

narration.en: Move a compass around a bar magnet and watch its needle line up with the field. Drag the compass all round the magnet: the needle always points along the field line there. Flip the magnet: every needle turns round by 180°. Notice that the needle swings a few times before it settles: that is the oscillation of a dipole in a field.

problem.en: A short bar magnet placed at 30° to a uniform field of 0.25 T experiences a torque of 4.5 × 10⁻² N m. Find its magnetic moment.

steps.en: τ = mB sin θ, so m = τ/(B sin θ).

narration.en: Let us solve this together. A short bar magnet placed at 30° to a uniform field of 0.25 T experiences a torque of 4.5 × 10⁻² N m. Find its magnetic moment.

problem.en: How much work is needed to turn the same magnet (m = 0.36 J T⁻¹, B = 0.25 T) from its stable position to its unstable position?

steps.en: W = mB(cos θ₁ − cos θ₂) with θ₁ = 0°, θ₂ = 180°.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. How much work is needed to turn the same magnet (m = 0.36 J T⁻¹, B = 0.25 T) from its stable position to its unstable position?

body.en: From aligned to perpendicular: W = mB. From aligned to opposite: W = 2mB. The same rules hold for an electric dipole with p and E.

narration.en: Turning a dipole. From aligned to perpendicular: W = mB. From aligned to opposite: W = 2mB. The same rules hold for an electric dipole with p and E.
Team quiz. Each team discusses quietly and gives one answer.

points.en: τ = mB sin θ; U = −mB cos θ.
Stable at 0°, unstable at 180°; flipping costs 2mB.
points.kn: 0° ನಲ್ಲಿ ಸ್ಥಿರ, 180° ನಲ್ಲಿ ಅಸ್ಥಿರ; ತಿರುವು ಹಾಕಲು 2mB.

homework.en: Write the electrostatic analogue of each formula in this lesson.

narration.en: Recap. τ = mB sin θ; U = −mB cos θ. Stable at 0°, unstable at 180°; flipping costs 2mB. Needle period T = 2π√(I/mB).
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. τ = mB sinθ; U = −mB cosθ. 0° ನಲ್ಲಿ ಸ್ಥಿರ, 180° ನಲ್ಲಿ ಅಸ್ಥಿರ; ತಿರುವು ಹಾಕಲು 2mB. ಸೂಜಿಯ ಆವರ್ತಕಾಲ T = 2π√(I/mB).
